AI Firm Anthropic Prepares for Major IPO Amidst Market Scrutiny

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly preparing for a significant initial public offering (IPO) this week, which is being viewed as a key test for the broader AI stock market. Wall Street is anticipating strong investor interest, with plans for associated products and events. This comes despite a general slump in AI stocks, with Nvidia's recent performance noted as potentially beneficial for Anthropic's launch. Analyst calls have also included mentions of Anthropic alongside other major tech companies.
